name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch

instructions.description: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward so both knees are bent about ninety degrees.
Tuck the pelvis slightly and stand tall through the trunk.
Gently shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the kneeling hip.
Hold steady breathing, then ease out and switch sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Hold each side without lumbar extension.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Use a split-stance standing position if kneeling is uncomfortable.

commentsNotes: Do not arch the lower back to create the stretch.
Place a pad under the kneeling knee if needed.
